_readme: Klook affiliate links. Every link gets ?aid=<aid> added at build time. To change a product, edit its url here and run: node scripts/build-guides.cjs && node scripts/apply-affiliates.cjs. Leave aid empty to remove every Klook box from the site.

sg-uss.name: Universal Studios Singapore tickets
sg-uss.blurb: Dated e-tickets for Sentosa's theme park. Book ahead for weekends and school holidays.

sg-gardens.name: Gardens by the Bay: Flower Dome & Cloud Forest
sg-gardens.blurb: Entry to the two cooled conservatories. The Supertree light show outside is free.

sg-safari.name: Singapore Night Safari
sg-safari.blurb: Evening wildlife park with the tram ride. Reserve your time slot after booking.

sg-pass.name: Klook Pass Singapore
sg-pass.blurb: Bundle several attractions in one pass. Worth it if you plan three or more paid sights.

my-petronas.name: PETRONAS Twin Towers Skybridge & observation deck
my-petronas.blurb: Timed entry to the bridge and level 86. Slots sell out, so book a few days ahead.

my-genting.name: Awana SkyWay cable car, Genting Highlands
my-genting.blurb: The gondola up to Genting, with a free stop at Chin Swee Temple.

my-bus.name: Singapore ⇄ Kuala Lumpur bus tickets
my-bus.blurb: Compare coach operators, times and pick-up points on one page.

th-safari.name: Safari World Bangkok
th-safari.blurb: Drive-through Safari Park plus the Marine Park shows in one ticket.

th-pass.name: Klook Pass Bangkok & Pattaya
th-pass.blurb: Several Bangkok and Pattaya attractions bundled into one pass.

jp-jrpass.name: Japan Rail Pass (whole Japan)
jp-jrpass.blurb: Unlimited JR trains, including most bullet trains. Check if it pays off for your route first.

jp-teamlab.name: teamLab Planets Tokyo
jp-teamlab.blurb: The walk-through digital art museum in Toyosu. Weekend slots sell out early.

jp-usj.name: Universal Studios Japan, Osaka
jp-usj.blurb: Studio Pass for the date you choose. Express Passes are sold separately.

bali-penida.name: Nusa Penida day trip from Bali
bali-penida.blurb: Kelingking Beach, Angel's Billabong and snorkelling, with boat transfers.

bali-batur.name: Mount Batur sunrise trek
bali-batur.blurb: Early-morning guided hike with hotel pick-up and breakfast at the top.

id-borobudur.name: Borobudur sunrise tour from Yogyakarta
id-borobudur.blurb: Sunrise viewpoint followed by the temple, with transport arranged.

vn-halong.name: Ha Long Bay day cruise from Hanoi
vn-halong.blurb: Caves, Ti Top Island and lunch on board, with transfers from Hanoi.

vn-bana.name: Ba Na Hills & Golden Bridge, Da Nang
vn-bana.blurb: Cable car, the Golden Bridge and the French Village. Lunch options available.

kr-lotte.name: Lotte World, Seoul
kr-lotte.blurb: Indoor and outdoor theme park in Jamsil. Bring your passport for foreigner tickets.

kr-everland.name: Everland day pass
kr-everland.blurb: Korea's biggest theme park, with shuttle-bus bundles from Seoul.

hk-ngongping.name: Ngong Ping 360 cable car
hk-ngongping.blurb: Cable car to the Big Buddha on Lantau. Crystal Cabin queues are usually shorter.

hk-pass.name: Klook Pass Hong Kong
hk-pass.blurb: Bundle Hong Kong attractions, with Disneyland as an optional add-on.

ae-desert.name: Dubai desert safari with BBQ dinner
ae-desert.blurb: Dune drive, camp shows and dinner, with hotel pick-up.

tr-balloon.name: Cappadocia hot air balloon flight
tr-balloon.blurb: Sunrise flight with hotel pick-up. Flights can be cancelled for weather, so plan a spare morning.

lk-sigiriya.name: Sigiriya & Dambulla day tour from Colombo
lk-sigiriya.blurb: Private car or van day trip. Rock and guide fees are usually extra.

ph-elnido.name: El Nido island-hopping tours
ph-elnido.blurb: Compare Tours A to D for the lagoons and beaches around El Nido.
